content.title: About
content.content: Bread, 100% whole wheat, is baked from the entire wheat kernel without removing the bran or germ. It has a dense crumb, a nutty flavor, and a high content of dietary fiber, vitamins, and minerals.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Whole‑wheat bread retains all parts of the grain, making it more nutritious than white bread.
In many countries, whole‑grain breads are traditional, such as German rye bread and Russian rye loaf.
The fiber content helps regulate blood sugar levels.
When stored properly, whole‑wheat bread stays fresh for up to a week.
Traditionally it is baked in stone ovens, giving the crust a distinctive aroma.

items.title: Rich in fiber
items.content: Fiber improves digestion, promotes satiety, and supports gut health.

items.title: Contains B‑vitamins
items.content: B1, B3 and B6 are involved in energy metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Source of minerals
items.content: Provides iron, magnesium, phosphorus and zinc, essential for bones and immunity.

items.title: Low glycemic index
items.content: Compared with white bread, whole‑wheat causes a slower rise in blood glucose.

items.title: Supports cardiovascular health
items.content: Beneficial fats and antioxidants help lower cholesterol levels.

items.title: Wheat allergy
items.content: People with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity may experience adverse reactions.

items.title: High carbohydrate content
items.content: Portion control is important for diabetics, as bread still contains significant carbs.

items.title: Phytic acid presence
items.content: Phytic acid can reduce mineral absorption; soaking the dough lowers its level.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Whole‑wheat bread is perfect for sandwiches, toast, serving with soups and salads. It can be toasted, used in breadcrumbs for casseroles, or as a base for croutons.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the bread in a paper bag or bread box at room temperature for up to 3 days. For longer storage, freeze it in an airtight bag – it will retain flavor and texture for up to 3 months.
